overview: Layouts range from two-storey townhomes to Fairway Villas with a penthouse level and Golf Mansions with a basement. GSA totals already include their published levels.
research.locationNote: Hudayriyat Island, Abu Dhabi. Golf access, membership charges and individual plot outlook require confirmation.
research.priceNote: Current Modon averages: 3BR townhome AED 4.2m; 4BR townhome 4.9m; Golf Home 7.4m; Range Villa 10.3m; Fairway Villa 26.8m; Mansion 35.8m; Par 3 4.9m; Par 4 6.6m. These are not starting quotations. Older factsheet townhomes start at AED 4.25m.
research.paymentNote: The undated original schedule totals 40/60. Construction instalments run March 2027–March 2030; confirm the applicable phase schedule.
research.handoverNote: Modon targets Q3 2030, with August 2030 in its FAQ. March 2030 is the final dated construction instalment, not handover.
